meta.note: HiPointe-DeMun tree census — this neighbourhood's OWN census, INDEPENDENT of Lafayette Square (never a fallback/copy). Same upstream service as LS (STL City Forestry) + adjacent geography, so species overlap heavily, but this is a SEPARATE asset with its own file.
meta.source: STL City Forestry inventory, clipped to the HiPointe-DeMun footprint (the SE City-limit wedge — the portion with a real municipal inventory).
meta.knownGap: The DeMun/Clayton (west) side has NO municipal tree inventory (Clayton's ~11k Davey survey is unpublished — records request pending). This census honestly covers only the City wedge; it is not padded with invented species. See memory project_hpdm_tree_census_jurisdiction_gap.
excluded: osm_trees (real positions, species mix-sampled → synthetic assignments)

origMeta.source: City of St. Louis Forestry Division
origMeta.coordinate_system: Local meters, compass-aligned (unrotated equirectangular about scene center).
